subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ards_only: all 14 transferred patients had influenza A (H1N1)-induced ARDS (Fig. 1). mixed_bmi: mean BMI 33.2 (ECMO) and 28.7 (no ECMO); several patients listed with obesity comorbidity but enrolment did not require obesity. timing_subgroup unclear: timing known only relative to referral/enrolment; days of mechanical ventilation prior to referral ranged 0–5 (Table 3). ptp_target_subgroups 'other': the target is an end-inspiratory transpulmonary pressure limit of 25 cmH2O, which does not match the end-expiratory or driving-pressure enum options.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: No overlap: single-centre (Molinette Hospital, Turin) cohort of 14 H1N1 ARDS patients referred October 2009–January 2010; no trial registration; not listed in any cluster in COHORTS.md; enrolment window and population (H1N1 ARDS referred for ECMO) do not match any other record in the review.
unclear_items: intervention.balloon_calibration: paper states only that PES was measured 'as previously described [20]' (Talmor reference); no filling volume, occlusion test, or position verification reported in the main text; supplementary material not available
design.countries: Italy inferred from author affiliations (Turin, Milan, Monza, Italy) and the Table 4 row 'Italy [18]'; the study setting country is not stated as a sentence
population.ards_definition_used: ARDS asserted but no definition (Berlin/AECC) cited
outcomes mortality: timepoint of the Table 3 Outcome column (A/D) is not defined — likely discharge from referring centre; recorded as not_reported

design.comparison_structure: coded within_patient_crossover because the seven no-ECMO patients were studied under two conditions (conventional then higher PEEP); the ECMO group contributed only the conventional condition
eligibility.criteria.adults_18_plus: no explicit age criterion stated; coded yes from adult ages in Table 3 and adult ICU setting
extraction_flags.general_notes: Balloon calibration and feasibility details may be in the electronic online supplement, which was not provided. Paired mean differences in paired_effects were computed from the reported condition means and are flagged derived; the paper reports the contrasts as changes with P values. Table 2 also reports VT, RR, PAO mean, pH, PPLATCW, ECW/ERS, and PaO2/FiO2 at all three conditions; all condition-level values are in the source table even where not every row was transcribed as a separate outcome entry.
